description: Fork of exp453 (LION beta=(0.9,0.95), 1.4967). 4x output-scatter sparsity on out_proj ONLY (the high-tph=1024 module); all other LUTs stay dense. Cleaner than exp460 (all-LUT 4x) which over-sparsified v_lut (16->4). out_proj: each table writes E/4=16 outputs scattered into the full E=64 output, so each out dim is built from ~256 tables (tph/4) instead of 1024. out_proj params 25.2M->6.3M, its output-write bandwidth 4x less; output dims unchanged. Q: how much bpb for 4x cheaper out_proj? Saves checkpoint.
